## Checklist

- [ ] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/JGalego/awesome-vericoding/blob/main/contributing.md).
- [ ] This pull request adds, changes, or removes one resource.
- [ ] I have used or read the resource, and I checked every link and claim myself.
- [ ] The entry follows the format: it starts with a capital letter, ends with a period, and avoids marketing language.
- [ ] It is in the right section and position: alphabetical for tools, by year for papers and verified systems.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes, or `python3 scripts/lint.py` does if you do not use pre-commit.
- [ ] I checked that the two neighboring entries still meet the quality bar, or I noted below what should change.
